faces.name: Super-Adaptoid
faces.oracleText:
Super-Adaptoid's power is equal to the number of legendary creatures you control.
Whenever Super-Adaptoid enters or attacks, choose another target creature. If that creature has haste and Super-Adaptoid doesn't, put a haste counter on Super-Adaptoid. Do the same for flying, first strike, double strike, deathtouch, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.

faces.name: Super Combo
faces.oracleText:
Replicate {2} (When you cast this spell, copy it for each time you paid its replicate cost. You may choose new targets for the copies.)
Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.

faces.name: Super-Duper Death Ray
faces.oracleText:
Trample (This spell can deal excess damage to its target's controller.)
Super-Duper Death Ray deals 4 damage to target creature.

faces.name: Super-Duper Lost
faces.oracleText: Put target creature into its owner's library just beneath the top X cards of that library, where X is the number of doors you can see from your seat.

faces.name: Super Intelligence
faces.oracleText:
Enchant creature
At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature's controller, that player draws a card.

faces.name: Superior Foes of Spider-Man
faces.oracleText:
Trample
Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater, you may exile the top card of your library. If you do, you may play that card until you exile another card with this creature.

faces.name: Superior Numbers
faces.oracleText: Superior Numbers deals damage to target creature equal to the number of creatures you control in excess of the number of creatures target opponent controls.

faces.name: Superior Spider-Man
faces.oracleText: Mind Swap — You may have Superior Spider-Man enter as a copy of any creature card in a graveyard, except his name is Superior Spider-Man and he's a 4/4 Spider Human Hero in addition to his other types. When you do, exile that card.
